//! Original Complete Replace preparation and freshly paid borrowed verification.

use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
use wf_domain::policy::complete::{
    CompletePolicyReplaceCaller, CompletePolicyReplaceFrameHeader,
    CompletePolicyReplaceInput, CompletePolicyEncodingError, CompletePolicyRequestError,
    PolicySchemaCharge, PolicySchemaLimits,
    prepare_complete_policy_replace_frame_caller,
    restore_complete_policy_replace_frame_header, scan_complete_policy_replace_frame,
};
use wf_domain::workflow::admission::AdmissionLimits;
use wf_domain::workflow::control::{EntryIdentity, PreparedDigest};
use wf_domain::workflow::request::gate::CommittedHeader;
use wf_types::version::LogIdentity;

use super::super::super::{CodecError, PreparedBytes, keys, writer::Writer};
use super::intent::{hash_intent, map_codec_error, write_replace_intent};

/// Verified original bytes and their restored private request header.
///
/// The header and hashes are mathematical preparation, not ordered authority.
pub struct VerifiedCompletePolicyReplaceFrame<'a> {
    header: CompletePolicyReplaceFrameHeader<'a>,
    digest: PreparedDigest,
    isolation: Vec<u8>,
}

impl<'a> VerifiedCompletePolicyReplaceFrame<'a> {
    /// Borrows the complete immutable input without a copied frame.
    #[must_use]
    pub fn encoded(&self) -> &'a [u8] {
        self.header.encoded()
    }

    /// Borrows the original complete original request without materializing a policy.
    #[must_use]
    pub fn original_intent(&self) -> &'a [u8] {
        self.header.original_intent()
    }

    /// Reads the recomputed identity of the complete frame.
    #[must_use]
    pub const fn digest(&self) -> PreparedDigest {
        self.digest
    }

    /// Borrows the canonical isolation bytes owned by this result.
    #[must_use]
    pub fn isolation_scope(&self) -> &[u8] {
        &self.isolation
    }

    /// Joins a separately supplied log identity to verified frame identity.
    #[must_use]
    pub fn header(&self, log: LogIdentity) -> CommittedHeader<'_> {
        CommittedHeader {
            format_version: 1,
            scope: self.header.scope(),
            request: self.header.request(),
            intent: self.header.intent(),
            identity: EntryIdentity::new(log, self.digest),
            stamp: self.header.stamp(),
            encoded_entry: self.header.encoded(),
            encoded_isolation_scope: &self.isolation,
        }
    }
}

/// Verifies original tag-six bytes on the caller's continuous schema account.
///
/// No complete policy is expanded and no current state or request gate is read.
///
/// # Errors
/// Preserves structural, profile, work, intent and fallible scope-output refusals.
pub fn verify_complete_policy_replace_frame<'a>(
    encoded: &'a [u8],
    limits: PolicySchemaLimits,
    admission: AdmissionLimits,
    charge: &mut PolicySchemaCharge,
) -> Result<VerifiedCompletePolicyReplaceFrame<'a>, CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    verify_replace_frame(encoded, limits, admission, charge)
}

fn verify_replace_frame<'a>(
    encoded: &'a [u8],
    limits: PolicySchemaLimits,
    admission: AdmissionLimits,
    charge: &mut PolicySchemaCharge,
) -> Result<VerifiedCompletePolicyReplaceFrame<'a>, CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    let scanned = scan_complete_policy_replace_frame(encoded, limits, admission, charge)?;
    let recomputed = Sha256::digest(scanned.original_intent()).into();
    let header = restore_complete_policy_replace_frame_header(
        scanned, recomputed, limits, admission, charge,
    )?;
    let isolation = keys::scope([
        header.scope().tenant().as_bytes(),
        header.scope().group().as_bytes(),
        header.scope().recovery().as_bytes(),
    ])
    .map_err(map_codec_error)?;
    let digest = PreparedDigest::new(Sha256::digest(header.encoded()).into());
    Ok(VerifiedCompletePolicyReplaceFrame {
        header,
        digest,
        isolation,
    })
}

/// Prepares exact original Complete Replace frame bytes under one continuous account.
///
/// Freshly admits raw owned input; no merged policy value replaces original identity.
///
/// # Errors
/// Preserves profile, work, scope, intent/frame caps and fallible output refusal.
pub fn prepare_complete_policy_replace_frame(
    input: CompletePolicyReplaceInput,
    limits: PolicySchemaLimits,
    admission: AdmissionLimits,
    charge: &mut PolicySchemaCharge,
) -> Result<PreparedBytes, CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    let (caller, intent_bytes, frame_bytes) =
        prepare_complete_policy_replace_frame_caller(input, limits, admission, charge)?;
    let intent_digest = hash_intent(&caller)?;
    let bytes = emit_replace_frame(&caller, &intent_digest, intent_bytes, frame_bytes)?;
    let digest = PreparedDigest::new(Sha256::digest(&bytes).into());
    Ok(PreparedBytes { bytes, digest })
}

fn emit_replace_frame(
    caller: &CompletePolicyReplaceCaller,
    intent_digest: &[u8; 32],
    intent_bytes: usize,
    frame_bytes: usize,
) -> Result<Vec<u8>, CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    let mut writer = Writer::allocate(frame_bytes, frame_bytes).map_err(map_codec_error)?;
    write_replace_frame_header(caller, intent_digest, intent_bytes, &mut writer)
        .map_err(map_codec_error)?;
    write_replace_intent(caller, &mut writer)?;
    if writer.len() != frame_bytes {
        return Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::EncodingMismatch.into());
    }
    writer.finish().map_err(map_codec_error)
}

fn write_replace_frame_header(
    caller: &CompletePolicyReplaceCaller,
    intent_digest: &[u8; 32],
    intent_bytes: usize,
    writer: &mut Writer<'_>,
) -> Result<(), CodecError> {
    let input = caller.input();
    writer.write(b"FWCP")?;
    writer.u16(1)?;
    writer.byte(6)?;
    writer.raw(input.scope().tenant().as_bytes(), 8_192)?;
    writer.raw(input.scope().group().as_bytes(), 256)?;
    writer.raw(input.scope().recovery().as_bytes(), 256)?;
    writer.raw(input.request().as_bytes(), 256)?;
    writer.u16(2)?;
    writer.write(intent_digest)?;
    writer.u64(input.stamp().hlc().physical().get())?;
    writer.u16(input.stamp().hlc().logical())?;
    writer.u64(input.stamp().wall().get())?;
    writer.u32(u32::try_from(intent_bytes).or(Err(CodecError::LengthOverflow))?)?;
    Ok(())
}

//! One paid caller walk and closed prepayments before owner movement.

use crate::policy::definition::{PolicyVersion, StateMode};
use crate::policy::{Backoff, BackoffKind, RetryOverride};
use crate::retention::RetentionOverride;
use crate::workflow::admission::AdmissionLimits;
use crate::workflow::request::RequestScope;

use super::super::admission::charge_schema;
use super::super::{
    CompletePolicyData, CompleteStatePolicyData, PolicySchemaCharge, PolicySchemaError,
    PolicySchemaLimits,
};
use super::{CompletePolicyReplaceCaller, CompletePolicyReplaceInput, CompletePolicyRequestError};
use measure::{IntentMeasure, MeasuredCompletePolicyIntent};

mod core_patch;
mod governance;
mod measure;

pub(super) use core_patch::{prepare_core_patch_caller, prepare_core_patch_frame_caller};

pub(super) fn prepare_caller(
    input: CompletePolicyReplaceInput,
    limits: PolicySchemaLimits,
    admission: AdmissionLimits,
    charge: &mut PolicySchemaCharge,
) -> Result<CompletePolicyReplaceCaller, CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    if charge.profile() != limits {
        return Err(PolicySchemaError::ProfileMismatch.into());
    }
    {
        let mut measure = IntentMeasure::new(charge);
        measure.node()?;
        check_header(input.scope())?;
        let measured = measure_intent(&input, limits, measure)?;
        prepay_intent(&measured, charge)?;
    }
    Ok(CompletePolicyReplaceCaller {
        input,
        schema_limits: limits,
        admission_limits: admission,
    })
}

fn check_header(scope: &RequestScope) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    // The immutable typed identities and stamp already enforce their individual invariants.
    let length = 18_usize
        .checked_add(scope.tenant().as_bytes().len())
        .and_then(|n| n.checked_add(scope.group().as_bytes().len()))
        .and_then(|n| n.checked_add(scope.recovery().as_bytes().len()))
        .ok_or(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow)?;
    if length > 8_192 {
        return Err(CompletePolicyRequestError::ScopeLimit);
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn measure_intent<'i>(
    input: &'i CompletePolicyReplaceInput,
    limits: PolicySchemaLimits,
    mut measure: IntentMeasure<'_>,
) -> Result<MeasuredCompletePolicyIntent<'i>, CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    let mut measured = MeasuredCompletePolicyIntent {
        tenant: input.scope().tenant().as_bytes(),
        data: input.data(),
        expected_generation: input.expected_generation(),
        bytes: 0,
        nodes: 0,
    };
    measure.write(b"WF-INTENT\0COMPLETE-REPLACE\0V2\0")?;
    measure.raw(measured.tenant, 8_192)?;
    measure.optional(measured.expected_generation.is_some())?;
    if let Some(expected) = measured.expected_generation {
        measure.u64(expected)?;
    }
    measure_data(measured.data, limits, &mut measure)?;
    (measured.bytes, measured.nodes) = measure.finish();
    Ok(measured)
}

fn prepay_intent(
    measured: &MeasuredCompletePolicyIntent<'_>,
    charge: &mut PolicySchemaCharge,
) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    let bytes = u64::try_from(measured.bytes).map_err(|_| PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow)?;
    let stream = measured
        .nodes
        .checked_mul(128)
        .and_then(|n| n.checked_add(bytes))
        .ok_or(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow)?;
    charge_schema(charge, stream, 0)?;
    let hash = bytes
        .checked_add(128)
        .ok_or(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow)?;
    charge_schema(charge, hash, 0)?;
    Ok(())
}

fn measure_data(
    data: &CompletePolicyData,
    limits: PolicySchemaLimits,
    measure: &mut IntentMeasure<'_>,
) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    measure.node()?;
    measure.raw(&data.workflow_type, 262_144)?;
    measure.optional(data.version.is_some())?;
    if let Some(version) = &data.version {
        measure_version(version, measure)?;
    }
    measure.optional(data.max_active_ms.is_some())?;
    if let Some(maximum) = data.max_active_ms {
        measure.u64(maximum)?;
    }
    measure.optional(data.retry.is_some())?;
    if let Some(retry) = &data.retry {
        measure_retry(retry, measure)?;
    }
    measure.optional(data.retention.is_some())?;
    if let Some(retention) = data.retention {
        measure_retention(retention, measure)?;
    }
    measure.count(data.states.len(), limits.policy_limits().max_states())?;
    for (name, state) in &data.states {
        measure.node()?;
        measure.raw(name, 262_144)?;
        measure_state(state, measure)?;
    }
    measure.optional(data.indexed_attributes.is_some())?;
    if let Some(names) = &data.indexed_attributes {
        measure_names(names, 3, 64, measure)?;
    }
    measure.optional(data.indexed_state_meta.is_some())?;
    if let Some(name) = &data.indexed_state_meta {
        measure.raw(name, 64)?;
    }
    measure.optional(data.governance.is_some())?;
    if let Some(governance) = &data.governance {
        governance::measure_governance(governance, measure)?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn measure_state(
    state: &CompleteStatePolicyData,
    measure: &mut IntentMeasure<'_>,
) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    measure.optional(state.mode.is_some())?;
    if let Some(mode) = state.mode {
        measure.u8(match mode {
            StateMode::Parallel => 0,
            StateMode::Fifo => 1,
        })?;
    }
    measure.optional(state.retry.is_some())?;
    if let Some(retry) = &state.retry {
        measure_retry(retry, measure)?;
    }
    measure.optional(state.retention.is_some())?;
    if let Some(retention) = state.retention {
        measure_retention(retention, measure)?;
    }
    measure.optional(state.governance.is_some())?;
    if let Some(governance) = &state.governance {
        governance::measure_governance(governance, measure)?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn measure_version(
    version: &PolicyVersion,
    measure: &mut IntentMeasure<'_>,
) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    match version {
        PolicyVersion::Bytes(bytes) => {
            measure.u8(0)?;
            measure.raw(bytes, 262_144)
        }
        PolicyVersion::Number(number) => {
            measure.u8(1)?;
            measure.u64(*number)
        }
    }
}

fn measure_retry(
    retry: &RetryOverride,
    measure: &mut IntentMeasure<'_>,
) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    measure.node()?;
    measure.optional(retry.max_retries.is_some())?;
    if let Some(maximum) = retry.max_retries {
        measure.u16(maximum)?;
    }
    measure.optional(retry.backoff.is_some())?;
    if let Some(backoff) = &retry.backoff {
        measure_backoff(backoff, measure)?;
    }
    measure.optional(retry.exhausted_to.is_some())?;
    if let Some(target) = &retry.exhausted_to {
        measure.raw(target, 262_144)?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn measure_backoff(
    backoff: &Backoff,
    measure: &mut IntentMeasure<'_>,
) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    measure.node()?;
    measure.u8(match backoff.kind {
        BackoffKind::None => 0,
        BackoffKind::Fixed => 1,
        BackoffKind::Linear => 2,
        BackoffKind::Exponential => 3,
    })?;
    measure.u64(backoff.base_ms)?;
    measure.u64(backoff.max_ms)?;
    measure.u8(backoff.jitter_pct)
}

fn measure_retention(
    retention: RetentionOverride,
    measure: &mut IntentMeasure<'_>,
) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    measure.node()?;
    measure.optional(retention.ttl_ms.is_some())?;
    if let Some(ttl) = retention.ttl_ms {
        measure.u64(ttl)?;
    }
    measure.optional(retention.history_max_events.is_some())?;
    if let Some(maximum) = retention.history_max_events {
        measure.u32(maximum)?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn measure_names(
    names: &[Vec<u8>],
    maximum_count: usize,
    maximum_bytes: usize,
    measure: &mut IntentMeasure<'_>,
) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    measure.count(names.len(), maximum_count)?;
    for name in names {
        measure.node()?;
        measure.raw(name, maximum_bytes)?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub(super) fn prepare_replace_frame_caller(
    input: CompletePolicyReplaceInput,
    limits: PolicySchemaLimits,
    admission: AdmissionLimits,
    charge: &mut PolicySchemaCharge,
) -> Result<(CompletePolicyReplaceCaller, usize, usize), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    if charge.profile() != limits {
        return Err(PolicySchemaError::ProfileMismatch.into());
    }
    let (intent_bytes, frame_bytes) = {
        let mut measure = IntentMeasure::new(charge);
        measure.node()?;
        check_header(input.scope())?;
        let measured = measure_intent(&input, limits, measure)?;
        let (header_bytes, header_nodes) =
            measure_replace_frame_header(&input, measured.bytes, charge)?;
        let frame_bytes = header_bytes
            .checked_add(measured.bytes)
            .ok_or(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow)?;
        if frame_bytes > admission.decision_bytes() {
            return Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::ByteLimit.into());
        }
        super::replace_frame::check_replace_frame_lists(measured.data, charge)?;
        prepay_intent(&measured, charge)?;
        prepay_replace_frame(&measured, header_bytes, header_nodes, frame_bytes, charge)?;
        (measured.bytes, frame_bytes)
    };
    Ok((
        CompletePolicyReplaceCaller {
            input,
            schema_limits: limits,
            admission_limits: admission,
        },
        intent_bytes,
        frame_bytes,
    ))
}

fn measure_replace_frame_header(
    input: &CompletePolicyReplaceInput,
    intent_bytes: usize,
    charge: &mut PolicySchemaCharge,
) -> Result<(usize, u64), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    let mut measure = IntentMeasure::new(charge);
    measure.node()?;
    measure.write(b"FWCP")?;
    measure.u16(1)?;
    measure.u8(6)?;
    measure.raw(input.scope().tenant().as_bytes(), 8_192)?;
    measure.raw(input.scope().group().as_bytes(), 256)?;
    measure.raw(input.scope().recovery().as_bytes(), 256)?;
    measure.raw(input.request().as_bytes(), 256)?;
    measure.u16(2)?;
    measure.write(&[0; 32])?;
    measure.u64(input.stamp().hlc().physical().get())?;
    measure.u16(input.stamp().hlc().logical())?;
    measure.u64(input.stamp().wall().get())?;
    measure.node()?;
    let intent_bytes = u32::try_from(intent_bytes).or(Err(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow))?;
    measure.u32(intent_bytes)?;
    Ok(measure.finish())
}

fn prepay_replace_frame(
    measured: &MeasuredCompletePolicyIntent<'_>,
    header_bytes: usize,
    header_nodes: u64,
    frame_bytes: usize,
    charge: &mut PolicySchemaCharge,
) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    let frame = u64::try_from(frame_bytes)
        .ok()
        .and_then(|n| n.checked_add(128))
        .ok_or(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow)?;
    charge_schema(charge, frame, 0)?;
    let header_bytes = u64::try_from(header_bytes).or(Err(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow))?;
    let header = header_nodes
        .checked_mul(128)
        .and_then(|n| n.checked_add(header_bytes))
        .ok_or(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow)?;
    charge_schema(charge, header, 0)?;
    let intent_bytes = u64::try_from(measured.bytes).or(Err(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow))?;
    let original = measured
        .nodes
        .checked_mul(128)
        .and_then(|n| n.checked_add(intent_bytes))
        .ok_or(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow)?;
    charge_schema(charge, original, 0)?;
    charge_schema(charge, frame, 0)?;
    Ok(())
}

//! Ownership-preserving outer Complete Replace and core Patch request admission.

use std::fmt;

use crate::workflow::admission::AdmissionLimits;

use super::{
    CompletePolicyEncodingError, PolicySchemaCharge, PolicySchemaError, PolicySchemaLimits,
};

mod caller;
mod core_patch_frame;
mod model;
mod replace_frame;

pub use replace_frame::{
    CompletePolicyReplaceFrameHeader, ScannedCompletePolicyReplaceFrame,
    restore_complete_policy_replace_frame_header, scan_complete_policy_replace_frame,
};

pub use core_patch_frame::{
    CompleteCorePolicyPatchFrameHeader, ScannedCorePatchFrame,
    decode_complete_core_policy_patch_frame_input, restore_complete_core_policy_patch_frame_header,
    scan_complete_core_policy_patch_frame,
};

pub use model::{
    CompleteCorePolicyPatchCaller, CompleteCorePolicyPatchRequestInput,
    CompletePolicyReplaceCaller, CompletePolicyReplaceInput,
};

/// Operational refusal of outer request preparation, before ordered installation.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum CompletePolicyRequestError {
    /// Complete schema or private canonical encoding admission failed.
    Encoding(CompletePolicyEncodingError),
    /// The complete derived request namespace exceeds its fixed bound.
    ScopeLimit,
    /// A supplied intent identity differs from its independently recomputed bytes.
    IntentMismatch,
}

impl fmt::Display for CompletePolicyRequestError {
    fn fmt(&self, formatter: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
        match self {
            Self::Encoding(error) => fmt::Display::fmt(error, formatter),
            Self::ScopeLimit => formatter.write_str("complete policy request scope limit exceeded"),
            Self::IntentMismatch => formatter.write_str("complete policy request intent mismatch"),
        }
    }
}

impl std::error::Error for CompletePolicyRequestError {}

impl From<CompletePolicyEncodingError> for CompletePolicyRequestError {
    fn from(error: CompletePolicyEncodingError) -> Self {
        Self::Encoding(error)
    }
}

impl From<PolicySchemaError> for CompletePolicyRequestError {
    fn from(error: PolicySchemaError) -> Self {
        Self::Encoding(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Schema(error))
    }
}

/// Bounds caller intent work on the same continuous schema account.
///
/// The selected profiles are retained without granting installation authority.
/// Caller construction and refused-owner destruction remain outside logical work.
///
/// # Errors

pub fn prepare_complete_policy_replace_caller(
    input: CompletePolicyReplaceInput,
    limits: PolicySchemaLimits,

/// Bounds original core-Patch frame preparation on one continuous schema account.

//! Complete borrowed preflight before semantic or envelope output.

use std::collections::BTreeSet;
use std::ops::Range;

use crate::policy::installation::{MAX_POLICY_GENERATION, MAX_POLICY_SNAPSHOT_BYTES, PolicyError};

use super::super::admission::charge_schema;
use super::{
    CompletePolicyEncodingError, PolicySchemaCharge, PolicySchemaError, PolicySchemaLimits, Reader,
};

mod governance;

pub(super) fn scan_value(
    encoded: &[u8],
    limits: PolicySchemaLimits,
    charge: &mut PolicySchemaCharge,
) -> Result<(u64, Range<usize>), CompletePolicyEncodingError> {
    let mut reader = Reader::new(encoded, limits, charge);
    reader.node()?;
    if reader.take(4)? != b"FWPV" {
        return Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Malformed);
    }
    if reader.u16()? != 2 {
        return Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::UnsupportedVersion);
    }
    let generation = reader.u64()?;
    if generation == 0 || generation > MAX_POLICY_GENERATION {
        return Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Schema(
            PolicySchemaError::Policy(PolicyError::InvalidGeneration),
        ));
    }
    let length = usize::try_from(reader.u32()?)
        .map_err(|_| CompletePolicyEncodingError::Schema(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow))?;
    if length > MAX_POLICY_SNAPSHOT_BYTES {
        return Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::ByteLimit);
    }
    let start = reader.position();
    let end = start
        .checked_add(length)
        .ok_or(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Schema(
            PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow,
        ))?;
    if encoded.get(start..end).is_none() {
        return Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Malformed);
    }
    if end != encoded.len() {
        return Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::TrailingBytes);
    }
    let mut snapshot = reader.region(start..end)?;
    scan_snapshot(&mut snapshot)?;
    snapshot.finish()?;
    Ok((generation, start..end))
}

fn scan_snapshot(reader: &mut Reader<'_, '_>) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyEncodingError> {
    reader.node()?;
    if reader.take(4)? != b"FWPS" {
        return Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Malformed);
    }
    if reader.u16()? != 2 {
        return Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::UnsupportedVersion);
    }
    scan_data_fields(reader)
}

pub(in crate::policy::complete) fn scan_data_fields(
    reader: &mut Reader<'_, '_>,
) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyEncodingError> {
    reader.raw(MAX_POLICY_SNAPSHOT_BYTES)?;
    reader.optional(scan_version)?;
    reader.optional(Reader::u64)?;
    reader.optional(scan_retry)?;
    reader.optional(scan_retention)?;
    let count = reader.count(reader.limits.policy_limits().max_states())?;
    let mut previous = None;
    for _ in 0..count {
        reader.node()?;
        let key = reader.raw(MAX_POLICY_SNAPSHOT_BYTES)?;
        if let Some(previous) = previous {
            reader.keys(previous, key, MAX_POLICY_SNAPSHOT_BYTES)?;
        }
        previous = Some(key);
        scan_state(reader)?;
    }
    reader.optional(|reader| scan_names(reader, 3, 64))?;
    reader.optional(|reader| reader.raw(64))?;
    reader.optional(governance::scan_governance)?;
    Ok(())
}

fn scan_state(reader: &mut Reader<'_, '_>) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyEncodingError> {
    reader.optional(|reader| match reader.byte()? {
        0 | 1 => Ok(()),
        _ => Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::UnsupportedTag),
    })?;
    reader.optional(scan_retry)?;
    reader.optional(scan_retention)?;
    reader.optional(governance::scan_governance)?;
    Ok(())
}

fn scan_version(reader: &mut Reader<'_, '_>) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyEncodingError> {
    match reader.byte()? {
        0 => {
            reader.raw(MAX_POLICY_SNAPSHOT_BYTES)?;
        }
        1 => {
            reader.u64()?;
        }
        _ => return Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::UnsupportedTag),
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn scan_retry(reader: &mut Reader<'_, '_>) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyEncodingError> {
    reader.node()?;
    reader.optional(Reader::u16)?;
    reader.optional(scan_backoff)?;
    reader.optional(|reader| reader.raw(MAX_POLICY_SNAPSHOT_BYTES))?;
    Ok(())
}

fn scan_backoff(reader: &mut Reader<'_, '_>) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyEncodingError> {
    reader.node()?;
    if reader.byte()? > 3 {
        return Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::UnsupportedTag);
    }
    reader.u64()?;
    reader.u64()?;
    reader.byte()?;
    Ok(())
}

fn scan_retention(reader: &mut Reader<'_, '_>) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyEncodingError> {
    reader.node()?;
    reader.optional(Reader::u64)?;
    reader.optional(Reader::u32)?;
    Ok(())
}

pub(super) fn scan_names(
    reader: &mut Reader<'_, '_>,
    maximum_count: usize,
    maximum_bytes: usize,
) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyEncodingError> {
    let start = reader.position();
    let count = reader.count(maximum_count)?;
    for _ in 0..count {
        reader.node()?;
        reader.raw(maximum_bytes)?;
    }
    let end = reader.position();
    let scratch = u64::try_from(count)
        .ok()
        .and_then(|n| n.checked_mul(64))
        .ok_or(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Schema(
            PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow,
        ))?;
    charge_schema(reader.charge, 0, scratch).map_err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Schema)?;
    let mut replay = reader.region(start..end)?;
    let count = replay.count(maximum_count)?;
    let mut names = BTreeSet::new();
    for _ in 0..count {
        replay.node()?;
        let name = replay.raw(maximum_bytes)?;
        let work = u64::try_from(name.len())
            .ok()
            .and_then(|n| n.checked_add(128))
            .ok_or(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Schema(
                PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow,
            ))?;
        charge_schema(replay.charge, work, 0).map_err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Schema)?;
        if !names.insert(name) {
            return Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Malformed);
        }
    }
    replay.finish()
}

//! Pure normalized V2 VALUE bytes through one parent-owned schema account.

use std::fmt;

use crate::policy::installation::{MAX_ENCODED_POLICY_BYTES, MAX_POLICY_GENERATION};

use super::admission::charge_schema;
use super::validation::admit_complete;
use super::{
    CompletePolicyCandidate, CompletePolicyData, CompletePolicyValue, PolicySchemaCharge,
    PolicySchemaError, PolicySchemaLimits,
};

pub(in crate::policy::complete) mod decode;
mod encode;
pub(in crate::policy::complete) mod reader;
pub(in crate::policy::complete) mod scan;
mod writer;

use reader::Reader;
use writer::Writer;

struct MeasuredPolicyV2<'v> {
    generation: u64,
    data: &'v CompletePolicyData,
    snapshot_len: usize,
    envelope_len: usize,
}

/// Normalized V2 content, wire, correspondence and allocation refusals.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum CompletePolicyEncodingError {
    /// Existing typed schema and operational work diagnosis.
    Schema(PolicySchemaError),
    /// The envelope or snapshot version is unsupported.
    UnsupportedVersion,
    /// An enum or boolean tag is unsupported.
    UnsupportedTag,
    /// An optional field has an invalid discriminant.
    InvalidOptionality,
    /// The encoded structure is incomplete or noncanonical.
    Malformed,
    /// Bytes remain after the declared envelope or snapshot.
    TrailingBytes,
    /// An actual or declared encoded byte length exceeds its cap.
    ByteLimit,
    /// A collection count exceeds its field limit.
    ItemLimit,
    /// Existing encoded bytes disagree with the normalized value.
    EncodingMismatch,
    /// A selected fallible vector reservation failed.
    AllocationFailure,
}

impl fmt::Display for CompletePolicyEncodingError {
    fn fmt(&self, formatter: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
        match self {
            Self::Schema(error) => fmt::Display::fmt(error, formatter),
            Self::UnsupportedVersion => {
                formatter.write_str("unsupported complete policy encoding version")
            }
            Self::UnsupportedTag => formatter.write_str("unsupported complete policy encoding tag"),
            Self::InvalidOptionality => formatter.write_str("invalid complete policy optionality"),
            Self::Malformed => formatter.write_str("malformed complete policy encoding"),
            Self::TrailingBytes => formatter.write_str("trailing complete policy bytes"),
            Self::ByteLimit => formatter.write_str("complete policy encoding byte limit exceeded"),
            Self::ItemLimit => formatter.write_str("complete policy encoding item limit exceeded"),
            Self::EncodingMismatch => formatter.write_str("complete policy encoding mismatch"),
            Self::AllocationFailure => {
                formatter.write_str("complete policy encoding allocation failure")
            }
        }
    }
}

impl std::error::Error for CompletePolicyEncodingError {}

/// Encodes admitted normalized V2 content, moving its original semantic owners.
///
/// The canonical bytes supply no namespace, hash, installation or source ETF proof.
/// Logical peak scratch excludes input construction, retained owners and native costs.
///
/// # Errors
/// Preserves profile/work diagnoses, maps current content to invalid authority, and
/// keeps new encoded-size and selected fallible reservation failures distinct.
pub fn prepare_complete_policy_value_v2(
    candidate: CompletePolicyCandidate,
    limits: PolicySchemaLimits,
    charge: &mut PolicySchemaCharge,
) -> Result<CompletePolicyValue, CompletePolicyEncodingError> {
    if charge.profile() != limits {
        return Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Schema(
            PolicySchemaError::ProfileMismatch,
        ));
    }
    if candidate.generation() == 0 || candidate.generation() > MAX_POLICY_GENERATION {
        return Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Schema(
            PolicySchemaError::InvalidAuthority,
        ));
    }
    admit_complete(candidate.data(), limits, charge, false).map_err(current_error)?;
    let encoded = {
        let measured =
            encode::measure_value(candidate.generation(), candidate.data(), limits, charge)?;
        encode::emit_value(&measured, limits, charge)?
    };
    Ok(CompletePolicyValue { candidate, encoded })
}

/// Re-admits current content and streams its V2 bytes against the existing owner.
///
/// No second encoded output is allocated. Success supplies no installed authority.
///
/// # Errors
/// Checks profile, generation and actual envelope length before current admission;
/// preserves operational errors and reports any subsequent byte disagreement.
pub fn verify_complete_policy_value_v2(
    value: &CompletePolicyValue,
    limits: PolicySchemaLimits,
    charge: &mut PolicySchemaCharge,
) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyEncodingError> {
    if charge.profile() != limits {
        return Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Schema(
            PolicySchemaError::ProfileMismatch,
        ));
    }
    if value.generation() == 0 || value.generation() > MAX_POLICY_GENERATION {
        return Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Schema(
            PolicySchemaError::InvalidAuthority,
        ));
    }
    if value.encoded().len() > MAX_ENCODED_POLICY_BYTES {
        return Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::ByteLimit);
    }
    admit_complete(value.data(), limits, charge, false).map_err(current_error)?;
    let measured = encode::measure_value(value.generation(), value.data(), limits, charge)
        .map_err(|error| match error {
            CompletePolicyEncodingError::Schema(error) => current_error(error),
            error => error,
        })?;
    encode::compare_value(&measured, value.encoded(), limits, charge)
}

/// Decodes one canonical normalized V2 VALUE after complete borrowed preflight.
///
/// Structural refusal precedes semantic/envelope outputs. Later typed refusal drops
/// materialized owners; construction, destruction and native costs remain separate.
///
/// # Errors
/// Preserves ordered wire and typed schema refusals, profile/work diagnoses, and
/// selected fallible vector reservation failures without resetting the account.
pub fn decode_complete_policy_value_v2(
    encoded: &[u8],
    limits: PolicySchemaLimits,
    charge: &mut PolicySchemaCharge,
) -> Result<CompletePolicyValue, CompletePolicyEncodingError> {
    let candidate = decode_complete_policy_candidate_v2(encoded, limits, charge)?;
    let work = u64::try_from(encoded.len())
        .ok()
        .and_then(|n| n.checked_add(128))
        .ok_or(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Schema(
            PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow,
        ))?;
    charge_schema(charge, work, 0).map_err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Schema)?;
    let mut copied = Vec::new();
    copied
        .try_reserve_exact(encoded.len())
        .map_err(|_| CompletePolicyEncodingError::AllocationFailure)?;
    copied.extend_from_slice(encoded);
    Ok(CompletePolicyValue {
        candidate,
        encoded: copied,
    })
}

/// Restores semantic owners without creating a second encoded envelope owner.
pub(super) fn decode_complete_policy_candidate_v2(
    encoded: &[u8],
    limits: PolicySchemaLimits,
    charge: &mut PolicySchemaCharge,
) -> Result<CompletePolicyCandidate, CompletePolicyEncodingError> {
    if charge.profile() != limits {
        return Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Schema(
            PolicySchemaError::ProfileMismatch,
        ));
    }
    if encoded.len() > MAX_ENCODED_POLICY_BYTES {
        return Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::ByteLimit);
    }
    let (generation, range) = scan::scan_value(encoded, limits, charge)?;
    let data = {
        let bytes = encoded
            .get(range)
            .ok_or(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Malformed)?;
        let mut reader = Reader::new(bytes, limits, charge);
        let data = decode::decode_snapshot(&mut reader)?;
        reader.finish()?;
        data
    };
    let candidate = super::restore_complete_policy(generation, data, limits, charge)
        .map_err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Schema)?;
    Ok(candidate)
}

fn current_error(error: PolicySchemaError) -> CompletePolicyEncodingError {
    CompletePolicyEncodingError::Schema(match error {
        error @ (PolicySchemaError::ProfileMismatch
        | PolicySchemaError::WorkBytes { .. }
        | PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow) => error,
        _ => PolicySchemaError::InvalidAuthority,
    })
}

//! Scoped request intent/replay over borrowed authoritative retained outcomes.

use std::collections::BTreeMap;

use wf_types::identity::{GroupId, RecoveryId, RequestId, TenantId};
use wf_types::version::CommittedTime;

use super::admission::{AdmissionError, AdmissionLimits};
use super::batch::{
    ApplyError, BatchDecision, BatchItem, BatchRejection, GroupView, decide_group_batch,
};
use super::control::{ControlPlan, ControlState, EntryIdentity};
use gate::{CommittedHeader, GateDecision, GateView, inspect_request};

mod claim;
mod dispatch;
pub mod gate;
pub mod indexed;
mod outcome;
pub mod policy;
pub use claim::decide_claim_request;
pub use dispatch::{DispatchDecision, DispatchPlan};
pub use outcome::{
    PolicyRejection, RequestValueError, RetainedMetadata, RetainedOutcome, RetainedStatus,
};

/// Stable server-bound tenant/group/recovery namespace, retained across retries.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct RequestScope {
    tenant: TenantId,
    group: GroupId,
    recovery: RecoveryId,
}

impl RequestScope {
    /// Combines validated opaque identities; current authorization stays outer.
    #[must_use]
    pub const fn new(tenant: TenantId, group: GroupId, recovery: RecoveryId) -> Self {
        Self {
            tenant,
            group,
            recovery,
        }
    }
    /// Borrows tenant identity, never credentials.
    #[must_use]
    pub const fn tenant(&self) -> &TenantId {
        &self.tenant
    }
    /// Borrows original group identity, independently of client routing hints.
    #[must_use]
    pub const fn group(&self) -> &GroupId {
        &self.group
    }
    /// Borrows recovery identity; disaster restore creates a new namespace.
    #[must_use]
    pub const fn recovery(&self) -> &RecoveryId {
        &self.recovery
    }
}

/// Versioned canonical client-intent digest, excluding prepared leader inputs.
///
/// Application verifies version-1 canonical bytes and SHA-256 before constructing
/// this explicit committed value. Public DTO/intent mapping and private committed
/// encoding are separate contracts. The domain performs no hash or encoding I/O.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct ClientIntent {
    version: u16,
    digest: [u8; 32],
}

impl ClientIntent {
    /// Admits the selected canonical intent version and explicit verified digest.
    ///
    /// # Errors
    /// Rejects an unsupported canonical default/field-normalization version.
    pub const fn new(version: u16, digest: [u8; 32]) -> Result<Self, RequestValueError> {
        if version == 1 {
            Ok(Self { version, digest })
        } else {
            Err(RequestValueError::UnsupportedVersion)
        }
    }
    /// Selects the complete-core-Patch registry after same-frame digest comparison.
    #[must_use]
    pub(crate) const fn complete_core_policy_patch(digest: [u8; 32]) -> Self {
        Self { version: 2, digest }
    }

    /// Selects the complete-Replace registry after same-frame digest comparison.
    #[must_use]
    pub(crate) const fn complete_policy_replace(digest: [u8; 32]) -> Self {
        Self { version: 2, digest }
    }

    /// Reads canonical intent normalization version.
    #[must_use]
    pub const fn version(self) -> u16 {
        self.version
    }
    /// Borrows stable client intent, independently of prepared identity.
    #[must_use]
    pub const fn digest(&self) -> &[u8; 32] {
        &self.digest
    }
}

/// One coherent tenant/group/recovery apply view, with retained outcome authority.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub struct RequestView<'a> {
    /// Server-bound namespace for both current records and retained outcomes.
    pub scope: &'a RequestScope,
    /// Current persisted control identity/time/checkpoint.
    pub control: ControlState,
    /// Complete authoritative group-local record/placement values.
    pub group: GroupView<'a>,
    /// Unique retained outcomes in exactly this request namespace.
    pub outcomes: &'a BTreeMap<RequestId, RetainedOutcome>,
}

/// Explicit immutable inputs verified by private committed-byte preparation.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub struct CommittedEnvelope<'a> {
    /// Private committed command schema version, separate from public wire.
    pub format_version: u16,
    /// Original server-bound scope, retained through redirects/retries.
    pub scope: &'a RequestScope,
    /// Stable caller request identity within this original scope.
    pub request: &'a RequestId,
    /// Canonical caller intent; excludes leader time/generated inputs.
    pub intent: ClientIntent,
    /// Full log identity and separately verified prepared-entry digest.
    pub identity: EntryIdentity,
    /// Validated leader-supplied trusted stamp; public clients cannot forge it.
    pub stamp: CommittedTime,
    /// Actual immutable prepared bytes; decoder verifies every supplied field.
    pub encoded_entry: &'a [u8],
    /// Actual isolation-scope encoding; outer decoder verifies typed scope binding.
    pub encoded_isolation_scope: &'a [u8],
    /// Bounded source atomic batch, with no implicit whole-partition copy.
    pub items: &'a [BatchItem<'a>],
}
impl<'a> CommittedEnvelope<'a> {
    /// Borrows the reusable header without exposing current operation guards.
    #[must_use]
    pub const fn header(self) -> CommittedHeader<'a> {
        CommittedHeader {
            format_version: self.format_version,
            scope: self.scope,
            request: self.request,
            intent: self.intent,
            identity: self.identity,
            stamp: self.stamp,
            encoded_entry: self.encoded_entry,
            encoded_isolation_scope: self.encoded_isolation_scope,
        }
    }
}

/// Request decision; replay borrows the original response owner unchanged.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum RequestDecision<'a> {
    /// First request needs one retained accepted/rejected outcome after persistence.
    Fresh(BatchDecision),
    /// Equal canonical intent returns exact original bytes/status/time/position.
    Replay(&'a RetainedOutcome),
    /// Stable request ID was reused for different intent; preserve original outcome.
    IntentConflict,
    /// Original retention guarantee expired; never reexecute this retained identity.
    Expired,
    /// Same full last log identity/digest/stamp; no state/control/outcome writes.
    LogReplay,
}

/// Proposed control and business values; atomic persistence is an adapter duty.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct RequestPlan<'a> {
    control: ControlPlan,
    decision: RequestDecision<'a>,
}

impl<'a> RequestPlan<'a> {
    /// Reads current processing control separately from an original retained result.
    #[must_use]
    pub const fn control(&self) -> ControlPlan {
        self.control
    }
    /// Borrows the fresh/replayed/rejected request decision.
    #[must_use]
    pub const fn decision(&self) -> &RequestDecision<'a> {
        &self.decision
    }
    /// Only fresh accepted/deterministic-rejected requests create retained outcomes.
    #[must_use]
    pub const fn requires_outcome_write(&self) -> bool {
        matches!(self.decision, RequestDecision::Fresh(_))
    }
    /// Transfers bounded decision and control values without cloning replay bytes.
    #[must_use]
    pub fn into_parts(self) -> (ControlPlan, RequestDecision<'a>) {
        (self.control, self.decision)
    }
}

/// Decides scoped request replay before any changed workflow guard/index lookup.
///
/// Current authorization is required before this API. The outer decoder verifies
/// canonical intent/prepared digest, actual bytes and complete scope. It atomically
/// persists fresh result bytes and control with workflow/index/history plans.
/// Host errors preserve all authority and cannot become retained business outcomes.
///
/// # Errors
/// Rejects foreign/corrupt authority, unsupported committed format, conflicting log
/// identity and invalid fresh execution time as apply failure.
pub fn decide_request<'a>(
    view: RequestView<'a>,
    envelope: CommittedEnvelope<'a>,
    limits: AdmissionLimits,
) -> Result<RequestPlan<'a>, ApplyError> {
    if view.group.group != view.scope.group() {
        return Err(ApplyError::InvalidAuthority);
    }
    let gate = inspect_request(
        GateView {
            scope: view.scope,
            control: view.control,
            outcomes: view.outcomes,
        },
        envelope.header(),
        limits,
    )?;
    let control = gate.control();
    let decision = match gate.decision() {
        GateDecision::Replay(retained) => RequestDecision::Replay(retained),
        GateDecision::IntentConflict => RequestDecision::IntentConflict,
        GateDecision::Expired => RequestDecision::Expired,
        GateDecision::LogReplay => RequestDecision::LogReplay,
        GateDecision::Fresh => {
            if envelope.items.is_empty() || envelope.items.len() > limits.batch_items() {
                RequestDecision::Fresh(BatchDecision::Rejected(BatchRejection::Admission(
                    AdmissionError::BatchItems,
                )))
            } else {
                if envelope
                    .items
                    .iter()
                    .any(|item| item.command.now != control.execution_time())
                {
                    return Err(ApplyError::InvalidAuthority);
                }
                RequestDecision::Fresh(decide_group_batch(
                    view.group,
                    envelope.items,
                    envelope.encoded_entry,
                    limits,
                )?)
            }
        }
    };
    Ok(RequestPlan { control, decision })
}

//! Private original core-Patch visitation for intent hashing and frame emission.

use wf_domain::policy::BackoffKind;
use wf_domain::policy::complete::{
    CompleteCorePolicyPatchCaller, CompleteCorePolicyPatchInput, CompletePolicyRequestError,
};
use wf_domain::policy::definition::{
    BackoffPatch, FieldPatch, PolicyVersion, RetryPatch, StateChange, StateMode, StatePolicyPatch,
};

use super::intent::{CompletePolicyIntentSink, IntentHasher, map_codec_error};

mod frame;

pub use frame::{CompleteCorePolicyPatchRequestPlan, decide_complete_core_policy_patch_frame};
pub use frame::{
    DecodedCompleteCorePolicyPatchFrame, VerifiedCompleteCorePolicyPatchFrame,
    decode_complete_core_policy_patch_frame, prepare_complete_core_policy_patch_frame,
    verify_complete_core_policy_patch_frame,
};

pub(super) fn hash_core_patch_intent(
    caller: &CompleteCorePolicyPatchCaller,
) -> Result<[u8; 32], CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    let mut writer = IntentHasher::new();
    write_core_patch_intent(caller, &mut writer)?;
    Ok(writer.finish())
}

pub(super) fn write_core_patch_intent<W: CompletePolicyIntentSink>(
    caller: &CompleteCorePolicyPatchCaller,
    writer: &mut W,
) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    let input = caller.input();
    let command = input.command();
    writer.write(b"WF-INTENT\0COMPLETE-CORE-PATCH\0V2\0")?;
    writer.raw(input.scope().tenant().as_bytes())?;
    writer.optional(command.expected_generation.is_some())?;
    if let Some(expected) = command.expected_generation {
        writer.u64(expected)?;
    }
    write_core_patch(command, writer)
}

fn write_core_patch<W: CompletePolicyIntentSink>(
    command: &CompleteCorePolicyPatchInput,
    writer: &mut W,
) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    writer.raw(&command.workflow_type)?;
    match &command.patch.version {
        FieldPatch::Unchanged => writer.u8(0)?,
        FieldPatch::Set(version) => {
            writer.u8(1)?;
            write_core_patch_version(version, writer)?;
        }
        FieldPatch::Clear => writer.u8(2)?,
    }
    match &command.patch.max_active_ms {
        FieldPatch::Unchanged => writer.u8(0)?,
        FieldPatch::Set(maximum) => {
            writer.u8(1)?;
            writer.u64(*maximum)?;
        }
        FieldPatch::Clear => writer.u8(2)?,
    }
    match &command.patch.retry {
        FieldPatch::Unchanged => writer.u8(0)?,
        FieldPatch::Set(retry) => {
            writer.u8(1)?;
            write_core_patch_retry(retry, writer)?;
        }
        FieldPatch::Clear => writer.u8(2)?,
    }
    match &command.patch.retention {
        FieldPatch::Unchanged => writer.u8(0)?,
        FieldPatch::Set(retention) => {
            writer.u8(1)?;
            write_core_patch_retention(retention, writer)?;
        }
        FieldPatch::Clear => writer.u8(2)?,
    }
    writer.count(command.patch.states.len())?;
    for (key, change) in &command.patch.states {
        writer.raw(key)?;
        match change {
            StateChange::Remove => writer.u8(0)?,
            StateChange::Patch(state) => {
                writer.u8(1)?;
                write_core_patch_state(state, writer)?;
            }
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn write_core_patch_state<W: CompletePolicyIntentSink>(
    state: &StatePolicyPatch,
    writer: &mut W,
) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    match &state.mode {
        FieldPatch::Unchanged => writer.u8(0)?,
        FieldPatch::Set(mode) => {
            writer.u8(1)?;
            writer.u8(match mode {
                StateMode::Parallel => 0,
                StateMode::Fifo => 1,
            })?;
        }
        FieldPatch::Clear => writer.u8(2)?,
    }
    match &state.retry {
        FieldPatch::Unchanged => writer.u8(0)?,
        FieldPatch::Set(retry) => {
            writer.u8(1)?;
            write_core_patch_retry(retry, writer)?;
        }
        FieldPatch::Clear => writer.u8(2)?,
    }
    match &state.retention {
        FieldPatch::Unchanged => writer.u8(0)?,
        FieldPatch::Set(retention) => {
            writer.u8(1)?;
            write_core_patch_retention(retention, writer)?;
        }
        FieldPatch::Clear => writer.u8(2)?,
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn write_core_patch_version<W: CompletePolicyIntentSink>(
    version: &PolicyVersion,
    writer: &mut W,
) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    match version {
        PolicyVersion::Bytes(bytes) => {
            writer.u8(0)?;
            writer.raw(bytes)
        }
        PolicyVersion::Number(number) => {
            writer.u8(1)?;
            writer.u64(*number)
        }
    }
}

fn write_core_patch_retry<W: CompletePolicyIntentSink>(
    retry: &RetryPatch,
    writer: &mut W,
) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    writer.optional(retry.max_retries.is_some())?;
    if let Some(maximum) = retry.max_retries {
        writer.u16(maximum)?;
    }
    writer.optional(retry.backoff.is_some())?;
    if let Some(backoff) = &retry.backoff {
        write_core_patch_backoff(backoff, writer)?;
    }
    writer.optional(retry.exhausted_to.is_some())?;
    if let Some(target) = &retry.exhausted_to {
        writer.raw(target)?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn write_core_patch_backoff<W: CompletePolicyIntentSink>(
    backoff: &BackoffPatch,
    writer: &mut W,
) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    writer.optional(backoff.kind.is_some())?;
    if let Some(kind) = backoff.kind {
        writer.u8(match kind {
            BackoffKind::None => 0,
            BackoffKind::Fixed => 1,
            BackoffKind::Linear => 2,
            BackoffKind::Exponential => 3,
        })?;

    writer.optional(backoff.base_ms.is_some())?;
    if let Some(base) = backoff.base_ms {
        writer.u64(base)?;
    }
    writer.optional(backoff.max_ms.is_some())?;
    if let Some(maximum) = backoff.max_ms {
        writer.u64(maximum)?;
    }
    writer.optional(backoff.jitter_pct.is_some())?;
    if let Some(jitter) = backoff.jitter_pct {
        writer.u8(jitter)?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn write_core_patch_retention<W: CompletePolicyIntentSink>(
    retention: &RetentionOverride,
    writer: &mut W,
) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    writer.optional(retention.ttl_ms.is_some())?;
    if let Some(ttl) = retention.ttl_ms {
        writer.u64(ttl)?;
    }
    writer.optional(retention.history_max_events.is_some())?;
    if let Some(maximum) = retention.history_max_events {
        writer.u32(maximum)?;
    }

//! Incremental Complete Replace intent hashing over original admitted owners.

use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
use wf_domain::policy::complete::{
    CompletePolicyData, CompletePolicyEncodingError, CompletePolicyReplaceCaller,
    CompletePolicyRequestError, CompleteStatePolicyData, PolicySchemaError,
};
use wf_domain::policy::definition::{PolicyVersion, StateMode};
use wf_domain::policy::{Backoff, BackoffKind, RetryOverride};
use wf_domain::retention::RetentionOverride;

use super::super::{CodecError, writer::Writer};

mod governance;

pub(super) trait CompletePolicyIntentSink {
    fn write(&mut self, bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError>;

    fn raw(&mut self, bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
        self.count(bytes.len())?;
        self.write(bytes)
    }

    fn count(&mut self, count: usize) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
        self.u32(u32::try_from(count).or(Err(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow))?)
    }

    fn optional(&mut self, present: bool) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
        self.u8(u8::from(present))
    }

    fn u8(&mut self, value: u8) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
        self.write(&[value])
    }

    fn u16(&mut self, value: u16) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
        self.write(&value.to_be_bytes())
    }

    fn u32(&mut self, value: u32) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
        self.write(&value.to_be_bytes())
    }

    fn u64(&mut self, value: u64) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
        self.write(&value.to_be_bytes())
    }
}

impl CompletePolicyIntentSink for IntentHasher {
    fn write(&mut self, bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
        IntentHasher::write(self, bytes)
    }
}

impl CompletePolicyIntentSink for Writer<'_> {
    fn write(&mut self, bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
        Writer::write(self, bytes).map_err(map_codec_error)
    }
}

pub(super) fn map_codec_error(error: CodecError) -> CompletePolicyRequestError {
    match error {
        CodecError::ScopeLimit => CompletePolicyRequestError::ScopeLimit,
        CodecError::LengthOverflow => PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow.into(),
        CodecError::Allocation => CompletePolicyEncodingError::AllocationFailure.into(),
        CodecError::ByteLimit | CodecError::ValueLimit => {
            CompletePolicyEncodingError::ByteLimit.into()
        }
        _ => CompletePolicyEncodingError::Malformed.into(),
    }
}


pub(super) struct IntentHasher {
    hasher: Sha256,
    bytes: usize,
}

impl IntentHasher {
    pub(super) fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            hasher: Sha256::new(),
            bytes: 0,
        }
    }

    pub(super) fn write(&mut self, bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
        let next = self
            .bytes
            .checked_add(bytes.len())
            .ok_or(PolicySchemaError::LengthOverflow)?;
        if next > 1_048_576 {
            return Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::ByteLimit.into());
        }
        self.hasher.update(bytes);
        self.bytes = next;
        Ok(())
    }

    pub(super) fn finish(self) -> [u8; 32] {
        self.hasher.finalize().into()
    }
}

pub(super) fn hash_intent(
    caller: &CompletePolicyReplaceCaller,
) -> Result<[u8; 32], CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    let mut writer = IntentHasher::new();
    write_replace_intent(caller, &mut writer)?;
    Ok(writer.finish())
}

pub(super) fn write_replace_intent<W: CompletePolicyIntentSink>(
    caller: &CompletePolicyReplaceCaller,
    writer: &mut W,
) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    let input = caller.input();
    writer.write(b"WF-INTENT\0COMPLETE-REPLACE\0V2\0")?;
    writer.raw(input.scope().tenant().as_bytes())?;
    writer.optional(input.expected_generation().is_some())?;
    if let Some(generation) = input.expected_generation() {
        writer.u64(generation)?;
    }
    write_data(input.data(), writer)
}

fn write_data<W: CompletePolicyIntentSink>(
    data: &CompletePolicyData,
    writer: &mut W,
) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    writer.raw(&data.workflow_type)?;
    write_version(data.version.as_ref(), writer)?;
    writer.optional(data.max_active_ms.is_some())?;
    if let Some(value) = data.max_active_ms {
        writer.u64(value)?;
    }
    write_retry(data.retry.as_ref(), writer)?;
    write_retention(data.retention.as_ref(), writer)?;
    writer.count(data.states.len())?;
    for (key, state) in &data.states {
        writer.raw(key)?;
        write_state(state, writer)?;
    }
    write_names(data.indexed_attributes.as_deref(), writer)?;
    writer.optional(data.indexed_state_meta.is_some())?;
    if let Some(name) = &data.indexed_state_meta {
        writer.raw(name)?;
    }
    governance::write_governance(data.governance.as_ref(), writer)
}

fn write_state<W: CompletePolicyIntentSink>(
    state: &CompleteStatePolicyData,
    writer: &mut W,
) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    writer.optional(state.mode.is_some())?;
    if let Some(mode) = state.mode {
        writer.u8(match mode {
            StateMode::Parallel => 0,
            StateMode::Fifo => 1,
        })?;
    }
    write_retry(state.retry.as_ref(), writer)?;
    write_retention(state.retention.as_ref(), writer)?;
    governance::write_governance(state.governance.as_ref(), writer)
}

fn write_version<W: CompletePolicyIntentSink>(
    version: Option<&PolicyVersion>,
    writer: &mut W,
) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    writer.optional(version.is_some())?;
    match version {
        None => Ok(()),
        Some(PolicyVersion::Bytes(bytes)) => {
            writer.u8(0)?;
            writer.raw(bytes)
        }
        Some(PolicyVersion::Number(value)) => {
            writer.u8(1)?;
            writer.u64(*value)
        }
    }
}

fn write_retry<W: CompletePolicyIntentSink>(
    retry: Option<&RetryOverride>,
    writer: &mut W,
) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    writer.optional(retry.is_some())?;
    let Some(retry) = retry else {
        return Ok(());
    };
    writer.optional(retry.max_retries.is_some())?;
    if let Some(value) = retry.max_retries {
        writer.u16(value)?;
    }
    write_backoff(retry.backoff.as_ref(), writer)?;
    writer.optional(retry.exhausted_to.is_some())?;
    if let Some(target) = &retry.exhausted_to {
        writer.raw(target)?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn write_backoff<W: CompletePolicyIntentSink>(
    backoff: Option<&Backoff>,
    writer: &mut W,
) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    writer.optional(backoff.is_some())?;
    let Some(backoff) = backoff else {
        return Ok(());
    };
    writer.u8(match backoff.kind {
        BackoffKind::None => 0,
        BackoffKind::Fixed => 1,
        BackoffKind::Linear => 2,
        BackoffKind::Exponential => 3,
    })?;
    writer.u64(backoff.base_ms)?;
    writer.u64(backoff.max_ms)?;
    writer.u8(backoff.jitter_pct)
}

fn write_retention<W: CompletePolicyIntentSink>(
    retention: Option<&RetentionOverride>,
    writer: &mut W,
) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    writer.optional(retention.is_some())?;
    let Some(retention) = retention else {
        return Ok(());
    };
    writer.optional(retention.ttl_ms.is_some())?;
    if let Some(value) = retention.ttl_ms {
        writer.u64(value)?;
    }
    writer.optional(retention.history_max_events.is_some())?;
    if let Some(value) = retention.history_max_events {
        writer.u32(value)?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn write_names<W: CompletePolicyIntentSink>(
    names: Option<&[Vec<u8>]>,
    writer: &mut W,
) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    writer.optional(names.is_some())?;
    let Some(names) = names else {
        return Ok(());
    };
    writer.count(names.len())?;
    for name in names {
        writer.raw(name)?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

    if let Some(scalar) = value.window_ms {
        writer.u64(scalar)?;
    }
    writer.optional(value.min_calls.is_some())?;
    if let Some(scalar) = value.min_calls {
        writer.u64(scalar)?;
    }
    writer.optional(value.failure_rate_pct.is_some())?;
    if let Some(scalar) = value.failure_rate_pct {
        writer.u8(scalar)?;
    }
    writer.optional(value.latency_threshold_ms.is_some())?;
    if let Some(scalar) = value.latency_threshold_ms {
        writer.u64(scalar)?;
    }
    writer.optional(value.half_open_max_probes.is_some())?;
    if let Some(scalar) = value.half_open_max_probes {
        writer.u64(scalar)?;
    }
    writer.optional(value.half_open_success_threshold.is_some())?;
    if let Some(scalar) = value.half_open_success_threshold {
        writer.u64(scalar)?;
    }
    write_names(value.error_classes.as_deref(), writer)
}

fn write_approvals<W: CompletePolicyIntentSink>(
    value: Option<&ApprovalsData>,
    writer: &mut W,
) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    writer.optional(value.is_some())?;
    let Some(value) = value else {
        return Ok(());
    };
    write_names(value.effects.as_deref(), writer)?;
    write_names(value.states.as_deref(), writer)?;
    write_names(value.assignees.as_deref(), writer)?;
    writer.optional(value.timeout_ms.is_some())?;
    if let Some(timeout) = value.timeout_ms {
        writer.u64(timeout)?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn write_enforcement<W: CompletePolicyIntentSink>(
    value: Option<LimitEnforcement>,
    writer: &mut W,
) -> Result<(), CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    writer.optional(value.is_some())?;
    if let Some(value) = value {
        writer.u8(match value {
            LimitEnforcement::StrictGlobal => 0,
            LimitEnforcement::ApproximateGlobal => 1,
        })?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

//! Narrow private-format preparation functions; no durable log is implemented.

use std::fmt;

use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
use wf_domain::policy::installation::{PolicyCandidate, PolicyLimits, PolicyValue};
use wf_domain::workflow::admission::AdmissionLimits;
use wf_domain::workflow::control::PreparedDigest;
use wf_domain::workflow::request::gate::CommittedHeader;
use wf_types::version::LogIdentity;

use crate::consensus::{PreparedOperation, PreparedRequest};

mod claim;
mod common;
mod complete_policy;
mod decode;
mod encode;
mod keys;
mod policy;
mod reader;
mod scan;
mod writer;

pub use complete_policy::{
    CompleteCorePolicyPatchIntent, CompletePolicyReplaceIntent,
    DecodedCompleteCorePolicyPatchFrame, VerifiedCompleteCorePolicyPatchFrame,
    decode_complete_core_policy_patch_frame, prepare_complete_core_policy_patch_frame,
    prepare_complete_core_policy_patch_intent, prepare_complete_policy_replace_intent,
    verify_complete_core_policy_patch_frame,
};
pub use complete_policy::{
    CompleteCorePolicyPatchRequestPlan, decide_complete_core_policy_patch_frame,
};

pub use complete_policy::{
    VerifiedCompletePolicyReplaceFrame, prepare_complete_policy_replace_frame,
    verify_complete_policy_replace_frame,
};

/// Immutable byte/count budgets shared by encoder, decoder and ordered apply.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub struct CodecLimits {
    admission: AdmissionLimits,
    policy: Option<PolicyLimits>,
}

impl CodecLimits {
    /// Uses validated immutable admission values; no local resource input is read.
    #[must_use]
    pub const fn new(admission: AdmissionLimits) -> Self {
        Self {
            admission,
            policy: None,
        }
    }
    /// Selects exact validated policy work bounds without changing payload limits.
    #[must_use]
    pub const fn with_policy_limits(admission: AdmissionLimits, policy: PolicyLimits) -> Self {
        Self {
            admission,
            policy: Some(policy),
        }
    }
    /// Resolves the immutable v1 policy profile, including its frozen default.
    #[must_use]
    pub fn policy_limits(self) -> PolicyLimits {
        self.policy.unwrap_or_default()
    }
    /// Reads the replicated profile used for all actual encoded data.
    #[must_use]
    pub const fn admission(self) -> AdmissionLimits {
        self.admission
    }
}

/// Exact private prepared bytes with SHA256 identity; no own digest field exists.
pub struct PreparedBytes {
    bytes: Vec<u8>,
    digest: PreparedDigest,
}

impl PreparedBytes {
    /// Borrows immutable canonical bytes, excluding separately assigned log ID.
    #[must_use]
    pub fn as_bytes(&self) -> &[u8] {
        &self.bytes
    }
    /// Reads prepared identity independently from client intent and log identity.
    #[must_use]
    pub const fn digest(&self) -> PreparedDigest {
        self.digest
    }
}

/// Decoded typed request bound to actual immutable input bytes.
pub struct DecodedRequest<'a> {
    request: PreparedRequest,
    encoded: &'a [u8],
    digest: PreparedDigest,
    isolation: Vec<u8>,
    state_keys: Vec<Vec<u8>>,
    claim_filters: Option<claim::ClaimFilterRefs<'a>>,
}

impl DecodedRequest<'_> {
    /// Borrows the decoded explicit values; current state still requires authority.
    #[must_use]
    pub const fn request(&self) -> &PreparedRequest {
        &self.request
    }
    /// Reads a recomputed identity over exact input bytes.
    #[must_use]
    pub const fn digest(&self) -> PreparedDigest {
        self.digest
    }
    /// Borrows exact input bytes; no complete canonical reencode is required.
    #[must_use]
    pub const fn encoded(&self) -> &[u8] {
        self.encoded
    }
    /// Borrows actual isolation bytes derived from the decoded namespace.
    #[must_use]
    pub fn isolation_scope(&self) -> &[u8] {
        &self.isolation
    }
    /// Borrows the complete derived state key for one represented batch item.
    #[must_use]
    pub fn state_key(&self, index: usize) -> Option<&[u8]> {
        self.state_keys.get(index).map(Vec::as_slice)
    }
    /// Borrows the represented payload/result/error fields without another copy.
    #[must_use]
    pub fn value_bytes(&self, index: usize) -> Option<[Option<&[u8]>; 2]> {
        use wf_domain::workflow::Operation;

        let PreparedOperation::Batch(items) = &self.request.operation else {
            return None;
        };
        let operation = &items.get(index)?.command.operation;
        Some(match operation {
            Operation::Create(value) => [value.payload.as_deref(), None],
            Operation::Transition(value) => [value.payload.as_deref(), None],
            Operation::Complete(value) | Operation::Fail(value) => {
                [value.payload.as_deref(), value.value.as_deref()]
            }
            Operation::Retry(value) => [value.payload.as_deref(), value.error.as_deref()],
            Operation::RetryWithPolicy(value) => [value.payload.as_deref(), value.error.as_deref()],
            Operation::Cancel(value) => [value.error.as_deref(), None],
            Operation::Claim(_) | Operation::Reclaim(_) | Operation::ExtendLease(_) => [None, None],
        })
    }
    /// Joins separately assigned log identity to verified prepared-byte identity.
    /// Current authorization and coherent apply authority still precede dispatch.
    #[must_use]
    pub fn header(&self, log: LogIdentity) -> CommittedHeader<'_> {
        CommittedHeader {
            format_version: 1,
            scope: &self.request.scope,
            request: &self.request.request,
            intent: self.request.intent,
            identity: wf_domain::workflow::control::EntryIdentity::new(log, self.digest),
            stamp: self.request.stamp,
            encoded_entry: self.encoded,
            encoded_isolation_scope: &self.isolation,
        }
    }
    /// Borrows the exact decoded policy command/value and original request header.
    #[must_use]
    pub fn policy_envelope(
        &self,
        log: LogIdentity,
    ) -> Option<wf_domain::workflow::request::policy::PolicyEnvelope<'_>> {
        let PreparedOperation::InstallPolicy { command, value } = &self.request.operation else {
            return None;
        };
        Some(wf_domain::workflow::request::policy::PolicyEnvelope {
            header: self.header(log),
            command,
            prepared: value,
        })
    }
    /// Borrows physical query filters and binds separately assigned committed identity.
    /// Selection and current authority are supplied by the ordered apply owner.
    #[must_use]
    pub fn claim_envelope(
        &self,
        log: LogIdentity,
    ) -> Option<wf_domain::claim::apply::ClaimEnvelope<'_>> {
        use wf_domain::claim::PartitionFilter;
        use wf_domain::claim::apply::{ClaimEnvelope, ClaimQuery, ClaimStates};

        let PreparedOperation::ClaimPhase(phase) = &self.request.operation else {
            return None;
        };
        let filters = self.claim_filters.as_ref()?;
        Some(ClaimEnvelope {
            header: self.header(log),
            query: ClaimQuery {
                workflow_type: &phase.query.workflow_type,
                partitions: if phase.query.partitions.is_some() {
                    PartitionFilter::Only(&filters[2])
                } else {
                    PartitionFilter::Any
                },
                states: if phase.query.states.is_some() {
                    ClaimStates::Only(&filters[0])
                } else {
                    ClaimStates::Any
                },
                exclude_states: &filters[1],
                priority: phase.query.priority,
                worker: &phase.query.worker,
                lease_ms: phase.query.lease_ms,
                limit: phase.query.limit,
            },
            token_version: phase.token_version,
            first_ordinal: phase.first_ordinal,
            scan_budget: phase.scan_budget,
            head_budget: phase.head_budget,
            resume: None,
        })
    }
}

/// Operational preparation/corruption failure; never a retained business outcome.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum CodecError {
    /// Private command version is unsupported.
    UnsupportedVersion,
    /// An operation/backoff discriminator is unknown.
    UnsupportedTag,
    /// A present/absent tag is neither zero nor one.
    InvalidOptionality,
    /// Fixed fields, typed identities or input continuity are invalid.
    Malformed,
    /// Bytes remain after the complete represented command.
    TrailingBytes,
    /// Complete input/output or derived-key aggregate exceeds its profile.
    ByteLimit,
    /// A batch is empty or a batch/filter count exceeds its structural profile.
    ItemLimit,
    /// A length-prefixed variable/nested field exceeds its configured byte cap.
    ValueLimit,
    /// Complete derived state key exceeds 65,535 bytes.
    KeyLimit,
    /// Complete derived isolation scope exceeds 8,192 bytes.
    ScopeLimit,
    /// A checked length/count cannot fit its explicit representation.
    LengthOverflow,
    /// A safe fallible builder reservation failed.
    Allocation,
}

impl fmt::Display for CodecError {
    fn fmt(&self, formatter: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
        formatter.write_str(match self {
            Self::UnsupportedVersion => "unsupported private prepared version",
            Self::UnsupportedTag => "unsupported private prepared tag",
            Self::InvalidOptionality => "invalid private prepared optionality",
            Self::Malformed => "malformed private prepared command",
            Self::TrailingBytes => "trailing private prepared bytes",
            Self::ByteLimit => "private prepared byte budget exceeded",
            Self::ItemLimit => "private prepared item budget exceeded",
            Self::ValueLimit => "private prepared field budget exceeded",
            Self::KeyLimit => "private prepared state key too large",
            Self::ScopeLimit => "private prepared isolation scope too large",
            Self::LengthOverflow => "private prepared length overflow",
            Self::Allocation => "private prepared allocation failed",
        })
    }
}
impl std::error::Error for CodecError {}

/// Prepares one normalized policy envelope without installation or submission.
///
/// # Errors
/// Rejects malformed values or complete private snapshot/envelope limits.
pub fn prepare_policy(
    candidate: PolicyCandidate,
    limits: CodecLimits,
) -> Result<PolicyValue, CodecError> {
    policy::prepare(candidate, limits)
}

/// Encodes only supported typed preparation values without submission/effects.
///
/// # Errors
/// Rejects unsupported/malformed structure and immutable resource bounds.
pub fn encode_prepared(
    request: &PreparedRequest,
    limits: CodecLimits,
) -> Result<PreparedBytes, CodecError> {
    if let PreparedOperation::InstallPolicy { value, .. } = &request.operation {
        policy::verify(value, limits)?;
    }
    let mut measure = writer::Writer::measure(limits.admission.decision_bytes());
    encode::write(request, &mut measure, limits)?;
    let mut output = writer::Writer::allocate(measure.len(), limits.admission.decision_bytes())?;
    encode::write(request, &mut output, limits)?;
    let bytes = output.finish()?;
    Ok(PreparedBytes {
        digest: digest(&bytes),
        bytes,
    })
}

/// Decodes exactly one bounded private command; public requests cannot use this.
///
/// # Errors
/// Rejects corruption/unsupported structure and immutable resource bounds.
pub fn decode_prepared(
    encoded: &[u8],
    limits: CodecLimits,
) -> Result<DecodedRequest<'_>, CodecError> {
    scan::preflight(encoded, limits)?;
    decode::read(encoded, limits)
}

fn digest(bytes: &[u8]) -> PreparedDigest {
    PreparedDigest::new(Sha256::digest(bytes).into())
}

#[test]
fn private_ports_codec_hash_policy_is_exact_and_cannot_leak() -> CheckResult<()> {
    let original = metadata()?;
    let policy = policy()?;
    let mut approved = original.clone();
    let dependencies = package_mut(&mut approved, "wf-ports")?["dependencies"]
        .as_array_mut()
        .ok_or("missing dependencies")?;
    dependencies.retain(|entry| entry["name"] != "sha2");
    dependencies.push(dependency());
    assert_eq!(
        graph::check(&approved, &policy, &root()?)?,
        Vec::<String>::new()
    );
    for (field, value) in [
        ("req", json!("=0.10.9")),
        ("source", json!("git+https://example.invalid/sha2")),
        ("features", json!(["std"])),
        ("uses_default_features", json!(true)),
    ] {
        let mut changed = approved.clone();
        let hash = package_mut(&mut changed, "wf-ports")?["dependencies"]
            .as_array_mut()
            .ok_or("missing dependencies")?
            .iter_mut()
            .find(|entry| entry["name"] == "sha2")
            .ok_or("missing exact hash")?;
        hash[field] = value;
        assert_ne!(
            graph::check(&changed, &policy, &root()?)?,
            Vec::<String>::new()
        );
    }
    for package in ["wf-types", "wf-domain", "wf-wire"] {
        let mut changed = approved.clone();
        package_mut(&mut changed, package)?["dependencies"]
            .as_array_mut()
            .ok_or("missing dependencies")?
            .push(dependency());
        assert_ne!(
            graph::check(&changed, &policy, &root()?)?,
            Vec::<String>::new()
        );
    }
    Ok(())
}

#[test]
fn complete_policy_outer_hash_and_dependency_boundaries_remain_closed() -> CheckResult<()> {
    let mut original = metadata()?;
    let rules = policy()?;
    let workspace = root()?;
    assert_eq!(
        graph::check(&original, &rules, &workspace)?,
        Vec::<String>::new()
    );
    let expected = dependency();
    let mut hash_count = 0;
    for entry in package_mut(&mut original, "wf-ports")?["dependencies"]
        .as_array()
        .ok_or("missing dependencies")?
    {
        if entry["name"] == "sha2" {
            for field in [
                "kind",
                "optional",
                "target",
                "source",
                "req",
                "features",
                "uses_default_features",
            ] {
                assert_eq!(entry[field], expected[field]);
            }
            hash_count += 1;
        }
    }
    assert_eq!(hash_count, 1);

    for package in ["wf-types", "wf-domain", "wf-wire"] {
        let mut leaked = original.clone();
        package_mut(&mut leaked, package)?["dependencies"]
            .as_array_mut()
            .ok_or("missing dependencies")?
            .push(dependency());
        assert_eq!(
            graph::check(&leaked, &rules, &workspace)?,
            vec![format!(
                "unclassified external edge {package} -> sha2 (normal, optional=false, target=null)"
            )]
        );
    }

    let mut backwards = original;
    let mut back_edge = dependency();
    back_edge["name"] = json!("wf-ports");
    back_edge["source"] = Value::Null;
    back_edge["req"] = json!("*");
    back_edge["path"] = json!(workspace.join("crates/wf-ports"));
    package_mut(&mut backwards, "wf-domain")?["dependencies"]
        .as_array_mut()
        .ok_or("missing dependencies")?
        .push(back_edge);
    assert_eq!(
        graph::check(&backwards, &rules, &workspace)?,
        vec![String::from(
            "forbidden declared edge wf-domain -> wf-ports (normal, optional=false, target=null)"
        )]
    );
    for module in [
        "policy::complete::outer::caller::core_patch",
        "policy::complete::outer::core_patch_frame",
        "policy::complete::outer::core_patch_frame::scan",
        "policy::complete::outer::core_patch_frame::decode",
        "policy::complete::outer::replace_frame",
        "policy::complete::outer::replace_frame::scan",
    ] {
        assert_eq!(
            super::source_check(
                "wf-domain",
                module,
                "use std::collections::BTreeMap; use wf_types::identity;"
            )?,
            Vec::<String>::new()
        );
        assert!(
            super::source_check("wf-domain", module, "use std::env;")?
                .iter()
                .any(|finding| finding.contains("unclassified standard-library module"))
        );
    }
    for facade in [
        "pub use crate::log::CompleteCorePolicyPatchIntent;",
        "pub use crate::log::VerifiedCompleteCorePolicyPatchFrame;",
        "pub use crate::log::DecodedCompleteCorePolicyPatchFrame;",
        "pub use crate::log::CompletePolicyReplaceIntent;",
        "pub use crate::log::VerifiedCompletePolicyReplaceFrame;",
        "pub use crate::log::prepare_complete_policy_replace_frame;",
        "pub use crate::log::verify_complete_policy_replace_frame;",
    ] {
        assert!(
            super::source_check("wf-ports", "client", facade)?
                .iter()
                .any(|finding| finding.contains("client port facade"))
        );
    }
    Ok(())
}
