```rust
//! Original Complete Replace preparation and freshly paid borrowed verification.

use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
use wf_domain::policy::complete::{
    CompletePolicyReplaceCaller, CompletePolicyReplaceFrameHeader,
    CompletePolicyReplaceInput, CompletePolicyEncodingError, CompletePolicyRequestError,
    PolicySchemaCharge, PolicySchemaLimits,
    prepare_complete_policy_replace_frame_caller,
    restore_complete_policy_replace_frame_header, scan_complete_policy_replace_frame,
};
use wf_domain::workflow::admission::AdmissionLimits;
use wf_domain::workflow::control::{EntryIdentity, PreparedDigest};
use wf_domain::workflow::request::gate::CommittedHeader;
use wf_types::version::LogIdentity;

use super::super::{CodecError, PreparedBytes, keys, writer::Writer};
use super::intent::{hash_intent, map_codec_error, write_replace_intent};

/// Verified original bytes and their restored private request header.
///
/// The header and hashes are mathematical preparation, not ordered authority.
pub struct VerifiedCompletePolicyReplaceFrame<'a> {
    header: CompletePolicyReplaceFrameHeader<'a>,
    digest: PreparedDigest,
    isolation: Vec<u8>,
}

impl<'a> VerifiedCompletePolicyReplaceFrame<'a> {
    /// Borrows the complete immutable input without a copied frame.
    #[must_use]
    pub fn encoded(&self) -> &'a [u8] {
        self.header.encoded()
    }

    /// Borrows the original complete original request without materializing a policy.
    #[must_use]
    pub fn original_intent(&self) -> &'a [u8] {
        self.header.original_intent()
    }

    /// Reads the recomputed identity of the complete frame.
    #[must_use]
    pub const fn digest(&self) -> PreparedDigest {
        self.digest
    }

    /// Borrows the canonical isolation bytes owned by this result.
    #[must_use]
    pub fn isolation_scope(&self) -> &[u8] {
        &self.isolation
    }

    /// Joins a separately supplied log identity to verified frame identity.
    #[must_use]
    pub fn header(&self, log: LogIdentity) -> CommittedHeader<'_> {
        CommittedHeader {
            format_version: 1,
            scope: self.header.scope(),
            request: self.header.request(),
            intent: self.header.intent(),
            identity: EntryIdentity::new(log, self.digest),
            stamp: self.header.stamp(),
            encoded_entry: self.header.encoded(),
            encoded_isolation_scope: &self.isolation,
        }
    }
}

/// Verifies original tag-six bytes on the caller's continuous schema account.
///
/// No complete policy is expanded and no current state or request gate is read.
///
/// # Errors
/// Preserves structural, profile, work, intent and fallible scope-output refusals.
pub fn verify_complete_policy_replace_frame<'a>(
    encoded: &'a [u8],
    limits: PolicySchemaLimits,
    admission: AdmissionLimits,
    charge: &mut PolicySchemaCharge,
) -> Result<VerifiedCompletePolicyReplaceFrame<'a>, CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    verify_replace_frame(encoded, limits, admission, charge)
}

fn verify_replace_frame<'a>(
    encoded: &'a [u8],
    limits: PolicySchemaLimits,
    admission: AdmissionLimits,
    charge: &mut PolicySchemaCharge,
) -> Result<VerifiedCompletePolicyReplaceFrame<'a>, CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    let scanned = scan_complete_policy_replace_frame(encoded, limits, admission, charge)?;
    let recomputed = Sha256::digest(scanned.original_intent()).into();
    let header = restore_complete_policy_replace_frame_header(
        scanned, recomputed, limits, admission, charge,
    )?;
    let isolation = keys::scope([
        header.scope().tenant().as_bytes(),
        header.scope().group().as_bytes(),
        header.scope().recovery().as_bytes(),
    ])
    .map_err(map_codec_error)?;
    let digest = PreparedDigest::new(Sha256::digest(header.encoded()).into());
    Ok(VerifiedCompletePolicyReplaceFrame {
        header,
        digest,
        isolation,
    })
}

/// Prepares exact original Complete Replace frame bytes under one continuous account.
///
/// Freshly admits raw owned input; no merged policy value replaces original identity.
///
/// # Errors
/// Preserves profile, work, scope, intent/frame caps and fallible output refusal.
pub fn prepare_complete_policy_replace_frame(
    input: CompletePolicyReplaceInput,
    limits: PolicySchemaLimits,
    admission: AdmissionLimits,
    charge: &mut PolicySchemaCharge,
) -> Result<PreparedBytes, CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    let (caller, intent_bytes, frame_bytes) =
        prepare_complete_policy_replace_frame_caller(input, limits, admission, charge)?;
    let intent_digest = hash_intent(&caller)?;
    let bytes = emit_replace_frame(&caller, &intent_digest, intent_bytes, frame_bytes)?;
    let digest = PreparedDigest::new(Sha256::digest(&bytes).into());
    Ok(PreparedBytes { bytes, digest })
}

fn emit_replace_frame(
    caller: &CompletePolicyReplaceCaller,
    intent_digest: &[u8; 32],
    intent_bytes: usize,
    frame_bytes: usize,
) -> Result<Vec<u8>, CompletePolicyRequestError> {
    let mut writer = Writer::allocate(frame_bytes, frame_bytes).map_err(map_codec_error)?;
    write_replace_frame_header(caller, intent_digest, intent_bytes, &mut writer)
        .map_err(map_codec_error)?;
    write_replace_intent(caller, &mut writer)?;
    if writer.len() != frame_bytes {
        return Err(CompletePolicyEncodingError::EncodingMismatch.into());
    }
    writer.finish().map_err(map_codec_error)
}

fn write_replace_frame_header(
    caller: &CompletePolicyReplaceCaller,
    intent_digest: &[u8; 32],
    intent_bytes: usize,
    writer: &mut Writer<'_>,
) -> Result<(), CodecError> {
    let input = caller.input();
    writer.write(b"FWCP")?;
    writer.u16(1)?;
    writer.byte(6)?;
    writer.raw(input.scope().tenant().as_bytes(), 8_192)?;
    writer.raw(input.scope().group().as_bytes(), 256)?;
    writer.raw(input.scope().recovery().as_bytes(), 256)?;
    writer.raw(input.request().as_bytes(), 256)?;
    writer.u16(2)?;
    writer.write(intent_digest)?;
    writer.u64(input.stamp().hlc().physical().get())?;
    writer.u16(input.stamp().hlc().logical())?;
    writer.u64(input.stamp().wall().get())?;
    writer.u32(u32::try_from(intent_bytes).or(Err(CodecError::LengthOverflow))?)?;
    Ok(())
}
```

```python
from pathlib import Path
import re,hashlib,json
base=Path('crates/wf-ports/tests/complete_policy_request')
expected={
'public_set.rs':'43112501cf8f4438cfe063cab7028068fd19f716df775c1c450bbc6366163215',
'public_set/frame.rs':'ff8ffc41c6d8e5faeb610e2a9f5e762be07429bf396e4f611f95fe7ef134936d',
'public_set/gate.rs':'9161f018c839d8f5ad8a8dad1b09fa29a2cd396470a46d4e1c9c13d80ff079d5',
'public_set/owners.rs':'445d45010bfeb923c0a25987d4eeff98f684976f090ea5b3a18d82b16f6e1831',
'public_set/refusals.rs':'53394a4730db2ee051268c8f43ba47fb5b63a18dfb27f90e80fee18480214453',
'public_set/source.rs':'2116e3b2e57c6cace83c2fe0757a871fb8bf84eef2ab2fe51b7df61bbf57009d'}
results={}
for path,sha in expected.items():
    s=(base/path).read_text()
    s=re.sub(r'((?:super::)?apply\(\n\s+)&(supplied,|view\()',r'\1\2',s)
    if path=='public_set.rs':
        s=s.replace("fn prepared(opts: Raw<'_>) -> TestResult<OriginalPolicySetRequest<'_>> {","fn prepared<'input>(opts: Raw<'input>) -> TestResult<OriginalPolicySetRequest<'input>> {")
        s=s.replace("supplied: &RawView<'view, '_, '_>","supplied: RawView<'view, '_, '_>")
        s=s.replace("OriginalPolicySetApplyView::new(*supplied, orders)","OriginalPolicySetApplyView::new(supplied, orders)")
        s=s.replace(".as_chunks::<2>()\n        .0\n        .iter()",".chunks_exact(2)")
    if path=='public_set/gate.rs':
        s=s.replace("assert!(std::ptr::eq(\n                    std::ptr::from_ref(replayed),\n                    std::ptr::from_ref(&outcomes[&request]),\n                ));","assert!(std::ptr::eq(replayed, &outcomes[&request]));")
        s=s.replace("assert_gate_boundaries(&supplied,","assert_gate_boundaries(supplied,")
        s=s.replace("assert_conflicts(&supplied,","assert_conflicts(supplied,")
        s=s.replace("supplied: &super::RawView<'_, '_, '_>","supplied: super::RawView<'_, '_, '_>")
    if path=='public_set/source.rs':
        s=s.replace("type SourceState<'a> = (&'a [u8], &'a str);\ntype SourceMapOrders = Vec<(u32, Vec<u32>)>;\n\n","")
        s=s.replace("states: (&[SourceState<'_>], &[SourceState<'_>]),","states: (&[(&[u8], &str)], &[(&[u8], &str)]),")
        s=s.replace("TestResult<(Vec<u8>, SourceMapOrders)>","TestResult<(Vec<u8>, Vec<(u32, Vec<u32>)>)>")
        s=s.replace("maps: &mut SourceMapOrders","maps: &mut Vec<(u32, Vec<u32>)>")
        s=s.replace("&canonical_text(","canonical_text(")
        s=s.replace("canonical_text(3, state)?, &config","canonical_text(3, state)?, config")
        s=s.replace('canonical_text(2, b"states")?, &states','canonical_text(2, b"states")?, states')
        s=s.replace("fn canonical_pair(id: u32, key: &[u8], value: &[u8])","fn canonical_pair(id: u32, key: Vec<u8>, value: Vec<u8>)")
        s=s.replace("out.extend_from_slice(key);","out.extend_from_slice(&key);")
        s=s.replace("out.extend_from_slice(value);\n    Ok(out)\n}","out.extend_from_slice(&value);\n    Ok(out)\n}")
    results[path]=hashlib.sha256(s.encode()).hexdigest()==sha
print(json.dumps(results,sort_keys=True))
assert all(results.values())
```

```rust
//! Isolated redb guard, transaction, and clean reopen checks.

#![forbid(unsafe_code)]

use redb::{
    Builder, Database, DatabaseError, Durability, ReadableDatabase, ReadableTable, TableDefinition,
    TableError,
};
use std::error::Error;
use std::ops::Bound::{Excluded, Unbounded};
use std::path::Path;

const DATA: TableDefinition<'static, &[u8], &[u8]> = TableDefinition::new("data");
const CONTROL: TableDefinition<'static, &[u8], &[u8]> = TableDefinition::new("control");
const KEYS: [&[u8]; 4] = [b"a", b"a\0", b"a\xff", b"b"];
const APPLIED: &[u8] = b"applied";
const CACHE_BYTES: usize = 16 * 1024 * 1024;

fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> {
    let path = Path::new(concat!(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"), "/state.redb"));
    let db = Builder::new().set_cache_size(CACHE_BYTES).create(path)?;
    check_atomic_tables(&db)?;
    check_write_guard_and_seek(&db)?;
    check_abort_and_reopen(db, path)?;
    println!(
        "redb 4.4.0: same-write guards/reseek, two-table abort/Immediate commit, \
         writer lock and clean reopen passed"
    );
    Ok(())
}

fn check_atomic_tables(db: &Database) -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> {
    for marker in [0_u8, 7, 8] {
        let mut write = db.begin_write()?;
        write.set_durability(Durability::Immediate)?;
        {
            let mut data = write.open_table(DATA)?;
            let mut control = write.open_table(CONTROL)?;
            let value = [marker];
            for key in KEYS {
                if key.len() > 64 || value.len() > 64 {
                    return Err("fixture key/value cap exceeded".into());
                }
                data.insert(key, value.as_slice())?;
            }
            if APPLIED.len() > 64 {
                return Err("applied key cap exceeded".into());
            }
            control.insert(APPLIED, value.as_slice())?;
        }
        if marker == 7 {
            write.abort()?;
        } else {
            write.commit()?;
        }
        let expected = [if marker == 7 { 0 } else { marker }];
        let read = db.begin_read()?;
        let data = read.open_table(DATA)?;
        let control = read.open_table(CONTROL)?;
        for key in KEYS {
            let value = data.get(key)?.ok_or("committed data key missing")?;
            assert_eq!(value.value(), expected.as_slice());
        }
        let applied = control.get(APPLIED)?.ok_or("applied marker missing")?;
        assert_eq!(applied.value(), expected.as_slice());
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn check_write_guard_and_seek(db: &Database) -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> {
    let write = db.begin_write()?;
    {
        let table = write.open_table(DATA)?;
        let point = table.get(KEYS[1])?.ok_or("point key missing")?;
        let mut range = table.range::<&[u8]>(..)?;
        assert!(matches!(
            write.open_table(DATA),
            Err(TableError::TableAlreadyOpen(_, _))
        ));
        for expected in KEYS {
            let (key, value) = range.next().transpose()?.ok_or("range ended early")?;
            assert_eq!(key.value(), expected);
            assert_eq!(value.value(), &[8]);
        }
        assert!(range.next().transpose()?.is_none());
        assert_eq!(point.value(), &[8]);
    }

    let mut position: Option<Vec<u8>> = None;
    let mut copies = 0;
    let mut seen = 0;
    loop {
        let next = {
            let table = write.open_table(DATA)?;
            let lower = position.as_deref().map_or(Unbounded, Excluded);
            let mut range = table.range::<&[u8]>((lower, Unbounded))?;
            match range.next().transpose()? {
                Some((key, value)) => {
                    let expected = KEYS.get(seen).ok_or("unexpected extra key")?;
                    assert_eq!(key.value(), *expected);
                    assert_eq!(value.value(), &[8]);
                    Some(copy_position(key.value(), &mut copies)?)
                }
                None => None,
            }
        };
        let Some(next) = next else {
            break;
        };
        // The old bound remains owned until the replacement copy has succeeded.
        position = Some(next);
        seen += 1;
    }
    assert_eq!(seen, KEYS.len());
    assert_eq!(copies, KEYS.len());
    assert_eq!(position.as_deref(), KEYS.last().copied());
    assert!(copy_position(&[0; 65], &mut copies).is_err());
    assert_eq!(copies, KEYS.len());
    assert_eq!(position.as_deref(), KEYS.last().copied());
    assert_eq!(seen, KEYS.len());
    for _ in KEYS.len()..8 {
        let owned = copy_position(b"x", &mut copies)?;
        assert_eq!(owned.as_slice(), b"x");
    }
    assert_eq!(copies, 8);
    assert!(copy_position(b"x", &mut copies).is_err());
    assert_eq!(copies, 8);
    assert_eq!(position.as_deref(), KEYS.last().copied());
    assert_eq!(seen, KEYS.len());
    write.abort()?;
    Ok(())
}

fn copy_position(key: &[u8], copies: &mut usize) -> Result<Vec<u8>, Box<dyn Error>> {
    if key.len() > 64 || *copies >= 8 {
        return Err("owned position cap exceeded".into());
    }
    let mut next = Vec::new();
    next.try_reserve_exact(key.len())?;
    next.extend_from_slice(key);
    *copies += 1;
    Ok(next)
}

fn check_abort_and_reopen(db: Database, path: &Path) -> Result<(), Box<dyn Error>> {
    let write = db.begin_write()?;
    drop(db);
    assert!(matches!(
        Builder::new().set_cache_size(CACHE_BYTES).open(path),
        Err(DatabaseError::DatabaseAlreadyOpen)
    ));
    write.abort()?;

    let reopened = Builder::new().set_cache_size(CACHE_BYTES).open(path)?;
    let read = reopened.begin_read()?;
    let data = read.open_table(DATA)?;
    let control = read.open_table(CONTROL)?;
    for key in KEYS {
        let value = data.get(key)?.ok_or("reopened data key missing")?;
        assert_eq!(value.value(), &[8]);
    }
    let applied = control.get(APPLIED)?.ok_or("reopened marker missing")?;
    assert_eq!(applied.value(), &[8]);
    Ok(())
}
```
